designChoices: Exterior widths, heights, support cross sections, nominal contact points and simplified rear fittings are visual construction choices constrained by multiple references, not measured engineering specifications.
Closed muzzle caps and shallow dark jacket marks are miniature-scale stylization; no operating internals.
Small pins, chains, straps and hidden feed paths excluded. Existing hatch-ring detail retained.
M2 nominal support bridges original fixed station to forward gun position required by the locked lid sweep; not an exact historical CWS mechanism.
M240 holder follows manual sheet-metal open-top interpretation rather than differing angular photograph equipment.
